message.content:
*   **Hierarchy & Contrast (Improved):** The redesign significantly improves visual hierarchy. The use of a distinct "Error/Warning" state for the configuration message and the addition of an action button ("إعادة المحاولة") provide clear focal points that were entirely missing in the flat, monotonous baseline.
*   **Information Density & Utility (Improved):** The "AFTER" screen demonstrates much higher functional density. It includes critical system feedback (the `CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED` warning) and actionable UI elements, whereas the "BEFORE" screen was a static wall of text with no interactive cues beyond the input field.
*   **Contextual Relevance (Improved):** The content in the "AFTER" image feels like a real-world scenario (a failed task requiring user intervention), making the product feel more "alive" and robust compared to the generic, seemingly successful response in the "BEFORE" image.
*   **Alignment & Layout (Regressed/Needs Work):** The text alignment within the main response bubble appears inconsistent or poorly justified. The right edge of the Arabic text looks ragged; if this is meant to be justified, the kerning or word-spacing algorithm is failing, leading to uneven "rivers" of space.
*   **Typography & Readability (Regressed/Needs Work):** The line height (leading) in the long paragraph of the "AFTER" image is too tight. For a dark-themed UI, this reduces readability and makes the dense technical text feel claustrophobic compared to the slightly more breathable spacing in the baseline.
*   **Visual Consistency (Needs Work):** There is a jarring mix of languages and scripts. While the UI is RTL Arabic, the error code (`CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED`) and technical values (`nvidia`, `zai_internal`) are in English. This is realistic for developers, but the styling of the English text doesn't feel fully integrated into the Arabic typographic hierarchy yet.
*   **Header Utilization (Neutral/Minor Regression):** The header in the "AFTER" image has more text on the left ("مرحلة معالجة بالذكاء الاصطناعي..."), which crowds the top-left anchor point. In RTL design, this can sometimes compete with the primary navigation/action items if not balanced correctly.
*   **Coherence Verdict:** It reads as a **more mature and functional** product because it handles edge cases (errors/configs). However, it does not yet read as a **polished** product due to the typography spacing issues and the slight visual clutter in the header.
*   **Specific Element - The Warning Banner:** The yellow warning icon and bold text are a great addition, but the background contrast of the warning area could be slightly more distinct from the main chat background to separate "system status" from "chat content."
*   **Specific Element - The Action Button:** The "Retry" button is a solid UX improvement, but its placement floating below a large block of text might cause it to be missed during scrolling. Pinning it or placing it closer to the error message would be stricter UI practice.
*   **Overall Impression:** The redesign moves from a "prototype" look to a "functional tool" look, but it needs a pass by a typographer to fix the line-height and justification issues in the Arabic text blocks.
